notes.title: Version 0.3 - Handful of Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Version 0.3 fixes a few bugs
[olist]
[*] Shift + Right Click was not working in builds. This was only an issue in levels 36-37
[*]Connecting a lever to another lever should no longer crash the game.
[*]If the game offers to let you skip a level and you don't skip, you will have to make 5 more attempts before being offered to skip again.
[/olist]
